svg.title: Compliance Dock — dimensioned architectural floorplan, revision P01
svg.desc: A2 sheet at 1 to 50. A 13.6 by 15.8 metre contained dock with a west office and concealed support bay, human and cargo scanners, cart bypass, sealed north access, route allowances, door swings and dimension chains. Authored planning contract; unverified in final geometry and runtime.

g.text: Contained arrival • controlled inspection • staff support
